limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The general corner adjunction and Morita theory are standard prior art. The new claim is restricted to the obstruction and correction for arXiv:2609.20230v1. The result treats finite vertex sets, does not determine flatness of Ap_H over the corner algebra, and does not assert that all downstream results of the source paper fail. A later author revision or an older equivalent observation in general corner-module language remains a residual originality risk. No independent validation is asserted.
provenance: A ring-theoretic analysis of hereditary saturated Kumjian–Pask corners, isolating the corner-unit obstruction to a claimed freeness theorem and the canonical corrected induction/restriction pair.
record_title: Corner units obstruct the claimed Kumjian–Pask freeness theorem
